must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap

notes: The RCA only restates symptoms (the container exited with Error and the Service has no ready endpoints) and suggests generic next steps. It never names nginx, the ConfigMap or the typo. It also hedges toward probes ('adjust probe settings'), which is close to the wrong 'readiness probe' answer but is not asserted as the cause.
